correctness.rationale: For coordinates (u,v,w) the dual Lipschitz norm is max(2|v|/t,2|w|/t,2|u|+|v|+|w|); symmetry averaging reduces all optimal ellipsoids to Q_a=a u²+v²+w². The exact corner maximum M_s(a) and facet minimum m_s(a)=min(s²,a/(2(a+2))) with s=t/2 follow from convexity and weighted Cauchy–Schwarz, with equality feasibility at the relevant transition. For a≤a0=4s²/(1−2s²) the relevant M/m decreases; for a≥a0 its denominator is s² and numerator nondecreases. Hence BM²=2+(1−t)²/(1−t²/2), sharp at a0, strictly decreasing from limiting 3 to 2. Independently optimized numeric ellipsoids at t=.1,.25,.5,.75,1 and verified exact ratios within <1e-8; this is corroboration only.
